T: Love, honour and a very complicated wedding.
D: A Brooklyn mob hitman falls for a woman who turns out to be in the same line of work.
P: Serve dessert at the wedding, when Charley first spots Irene.
S: olives, salami and marinated mushrooms for the reception
Marinate button mushrooms (blanched 1 minute) in oil, lemon, garlic and parsley overnight. Platter with salami, olives and marinated artichokes.
Chilled saffron risotto rolled around a cube of mozzarella, floured, egged and crumbed, fried at 175C until deep gold. Marinara for dipping.
Zucchini batons tossed in flour then dipped in a light batter of flour and sparkling water, fried at 185C, salt and lemon.
M: Ziti in slow sausage sugo layered with seasoned ricotta and mozzarella, baked at 200C until blistered.
Veal escalopes pounded thin, floured and seared 60 seconds a side, pan sauce of white wine, lemon, capers and stock, cold butter whisked in.
W: Amaretti: whisk 2 egg whites stiff, fold in 250g almond meal, 200g sugar and almond extract. Roll in icing sugar, bake at 170C for 15 minutes until crackled.
K: Prosecco chilled to 6C in an ice bucket, poured into flutes for the toast.

edition.tagline: Love, honour and a very complicated wedding.
edition.cue: Serve dessert at the wedding, when Charley first spots Irene.

s.note: Lemon marinated mushrooms, salami, mixed olives and tender artichokes.
s.how: Blanch 200g button mushrooms in boiling water for 1 minute and drain well. Toss with 2 tbsp olive oil, juice of half a lemon, 1 crushed garlic clove and 1 tbsp chopped parsley. Refrigerate covered overnight. Serve on a platter with 100g salami, 120g mixed olives and 150g drained marinated artichokes for four people.

s.note: Crisp battered zucchini batons with salt and fresh lemon.
s.how: Cut 2 medium zucchini, about 400g, into batons and pat dry. Toss with 30g plain flour. Whisk 100g plain flour with 150ml cold sparkling water to a light batter. Heat neutral oil in a deep sturdy pan to 185°C. Dip the batons in batter and fry in small batches for 3 minutes until crisp and golden. Drain, season with 1/4 tsp salt and serve with the remaining half lemon cut into wedges.

m.note: Slow sausage sugo, seasoned ricotta and mozzarella, baked until blistered.
m.how: Remove 400g Italian sausages from their casings. Brown in 1 tbsp olive oil for 8 minutes, breaking up the meat. Add 1 diced onion and cook 5 minutes, then 2 crushed garlic cloves for 1 minute. Add 700g passata, 150ml water and 1 tsp dried oregano. Simmer gently for 45 minutes, stirring. Boil 350g ziti or penne for 2 minutes less than the packet time. Mix 250g ricotta with 1/4 tsp each salt and pepper. Layer the pasta and sausage sugo with spoonfuls of ricotta in an ovenproof dish, scattering 200g mozzarella between layers and over the top. Bake at 200°C conventional for 25 minutes until piping hot and blistered; rest 10 minutes before serving.

w.note: Crackled amaretti with almond meal, sugar and a snowy icing coat.
w.how: Heat the oven to 170°C conventional. Whisk 2 egg whites to stiff peaks in a clean bowl. Gently fold in 250g almond meal, 200g caster sugar and 1/2 tsp almond extract. Shape into 20 small balls, roll in 40g icing sugar and space on lined trays. Bake 15 minutes until crackled and lightly golden. Cool on the trays for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack. Serve five small cookies each, or save extras in an airtight tin.

d.note: Chilled sparkling wine served in flutes for the wedding toast.
d.how: Chill one 750ml bottle of prosecco in an ice bucket for 30 minutes until about 6°C. Pour 125ml into each of four flutes for the toast. Keep the remainder cold with a sparkling-wine stopper.
